%PDF-1.7
trailer << /Root 1 0 R /Size 7 >>

1 0 obj
<< /Pages 2 0 R /Type /Catalog >>

2 0 obj
<< /Count 1 /Kids [3 0 R] /Type /Pages >>

3 0 obj
<< /Contents [4 0 R 5 0 R 6 0 R] /MediaBox [0 0 300 200] /Parent 2 0 R /Type /Page >>

4 0 obj
  << /Filter [/ASCII85Decode /FlateDecode] /Length <elided> >>
  stream
  1 0 0 rg 20 20 100 60 re f
  0 0 1 RG 4 w 150 40 m 280 160 l S
  endstream

5 0 obj
  << /Filter /RunLengthDecode /Length <elided> >>
  stream
  0 0.6 0 rg 160 120 120 60 re f
  endstream

6 0 obj
  << /Filter /ASCIIHexDecode /Length <elided> >>
  stream
  0.5 g 20 120 100 60 re f
  endstream
